description: Use this to read or set per-inbox send limits. Requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (omit when this key is limited to one inbox) and optional max_sends_per_day, domain_allow, domain_block, approval_keywords, and approval_amount_cents. Omit every limit field to read the current policy. Returns {object:"spend_policy", inbox_id, max_sends_per_day, domain_allow, domain_block, approval_keywords, approval_amount_cents, updated_at, enabled}. A send past max_sends_per_day is HTTP 429 send_limit_exceeded. A blocked domain is HTTP 403 recipient_domain_blocked. A domain outside a non-empty allow list is HTTP 403 recipient_domain_denied. A keyword or an amount at or above approval_amount_cents stages an owner-approval draft instead of sending, and that needs a verified owner. Null clears a numeric limit. COOPER_SPEND_LIMITS=off disables enforcement. The default is on. Same as GET and PUT /api/v1/inboxes/{id}/spend-policy.

approval_amount_cents.description: Amounts in the message at or above this many cents are held for owner approval. Null clears it.

approval_keywords.description: Case-insensitive substrings that hold the message for owner approval.

domain_allow.description: Recipient domains that may receive mail. Empty means every domain that is not blocked.

domain_block.description: Recipient domains that cannot receive mail.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or email. Omit it when this key is limited to one inbox.

max_sends_per_day.description: Maximum outbound messages per UTC day. Null clears the cap. Integer from 1 to 10000.

name: cooper_set_spend_policy
